Noon   ( aey payghumber ! ) qasam hai qalam ki , aur uss cheez ki jo woh likh rahey hain ,
apney perwerdigar kay fazal say tum deewaney nahi ho ,
aur yaqeen jano tumharay liye aisa ajar hai jo kabhi khatam nahi hoga .
aur yaqeenan tum akhlaq kay aalaa darjay per ho .
chunacheh tum bhi dekh lo gay aur yeh log bhi dekh len gay
kay tum mein say kon deewangi mein mubtala hai
yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar ussay bhi khoob janta hai jo apney raastay say bhatak gaya hai , aur unn logon  ko bhi khoob janta hai jinhon ney seedhi raah paali hai .
lehaza tum unn ki baaton mein naa aana jo ( tumhen ) jhutla rahey hain ,
yeh chahtay hain kay tum dhelay parr-jao to yeh bhi dhelay parr-jayen .
aur kissi bhi aesay shaks ki baaton mein naa aana jo boht qasmen khaney wala , bey wuqat shaks hai ,
taaney denay ka aadi hai , chughliyan lagata phirta hai ,
bhalai say rokney wala , ziyadti kernay wala , badd amal hai
badd mizaj hai , aur iss kay ilawa nichlay nasab wala bhi .
sirf iss wajeh say kay woh baray maal aur aulad wala hai .
jab uss kay samney humari aayaten parh ker sunai jati hain to woh kehta hai kay yeh pichlay logon  ki kahaniyan hain .
unqareeb hum uss ki soond per dagh laga den gay .

hum ney inn ( makkah walon ) ko issi tarah aazmaesh mein daala hai jaisay ( aik ) baagh walon ko uss waqt aazmaesh mein daala tha jab unhon ney qasam khai thi kay subha hotay hi hum iss baagh ka phal torr len gay
aur yeh ( kehtay huye ) woh koi istasna nahi ker rahey thay .
phir huwa yeh kay jiss waqt woh so rahey thay , uss waqt tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik bala uss baagh per phira laga gaee ,
jiss say woh baagh subha ko katti hoi kheti ki tarah hogaya .
phir subha hotay hi unhon ney aik doosray ko aawaz di ,
kay agar phal torrney hain to apney khet ki taraf saweray chal niklo .
chunacheh woh aik doosray say chupkay chupkay yeh kehtay huye rawana huye
kay aaj koi miskeen tumharay paas uss baagh mein naa aaney paye .
aur woh baray zoron mein tez tez chaltay huye niklay .
phir jab uss baagh ko dekha to kehney lagay kay :  hum zaroor raasta bhatak gaye hain ,
. ( phir kuch dair baad kay baad kaha kay : ) nahi ! balkay hum sabb lutt gaye hain .
unn mein jo shaks sabb say acha tha , woh kehney laga :  kiya mein ney tum say nahi kaha tha kay tum tasbeeh kiyon nahi kertay ?
kehney lagay :  hum apney perwerdigar ki tasbeeh kertay hain , yaqeenan hum zalim thay .
phir aik doosray ki taraf mutawajjah ho ker aik doosray ko malamat kernay lagay .
. ( phir ) sabb ney ( muttafiq hoker ) kaha kay :  afsos hai hum sabb per ! yaqeenan hum sabb ney sarkashi ikhtiyar kerli thi .
kiya baeed hai kay humara perwerdigar Allah hamen iss baagh kay badlay iss say acha ata farmadey . beyshak hum apney perwerdigar ki taraf rujoo kertay hain .
azab aisa hi hota hai , aur aakhirat ka azab yaqeenan sabb say bara hai . kaash yeh log jantay !
albatta muttaqiyo kay liye unn kay perwerdigar kay paas naimaton bharay baaghaat hain .
bhala kiya hum farmanbardaaron ko mujrimon kay barabar kerden gay-?
tumhen kiya hogaya hai ? tum kaisi baaten tey kerletay ho-?
kiya tumharay paas koi kitab hai jiss mein tum yeh parhtay ho
kay tumhen wahan wohi kuch milay ga jo tum pasand kero gay-?
ya tum ney hum say qayamat kay din tak baqi rehney wali qasmen ley rakhi hain kay tumhen wohi kuch milay ga jo tum tey kero gay-?
. ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say poocho kay :  inn mein say kon hai jiss ney iss baat ki zamanat ley rakhi ho-?
kiya khudai mein inn kay maaney huye kuch shareek hain ( jo yeh zamanat letay hun-? ) to phir ley ayen apney unn shareekon ko , agar woh sachay hain !
jiss din saaq khol di jaye gi , aur inn ko sajday kay liye bulaya jaye ga to yeh sajda ker nahi saken gay .

inn ki nigahen jhuki hoi hon gi , inn per zillat chai hoi hogi . uss waqt bhi unhen sajday kay liye bulaya jata tha jab yeh log sahih saalim thay , ( uss waqt qudrat kay bawajood yeh inkar kertay thay )
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log iss kalam ko jhutla rahey hain unhen mujh per chorr do . hum unhen iss tarah dheeray dheeray ( tabahi ki taraf ) ley jayen gay kay unhen pata bhi nahi chalay ga .
aur mein unhen dheel dey raha hun . yaqeen rakho meri tadbeer bari mazboot hai .
kiya tum unn say koi ujrat maang rahey ho kay woh tawaan kay bojh say dabay jarahey hain-?
ya unn kay paas ghaib ka ilm hai jissay woh likh rahey hun-?
gharz tum apney perwerdigar ka hukum aaney tak sabar kiye jao , aur machli walay ki tarah matt hojana ,   jab unhon ney ghum say ghutt ghutt ker ( hamen ) pukara tha .
agar unn kay perwerdigar kay fazal ney unhen sanbhal naa liya hota to unhen buri halat kay sath ussi khulay meydan mein phenk diya jata .
phir unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen muntakhib farma liya , aur unhen sualeheen mein shamil kerdiya .

jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai jab woh naseehat ki yeh baat suntay hain to aisa lagta hai kay yeh apni ( tez tez ) aankhon say tumhen dagmaga den gay , aur woh kehtay hain kay yeh shaks to deewana hai .
halankay yeh to duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye aik naseehat hi naseehat hai .
